title: teucrium pampaninii
intro: Teucrium pampaninii, commonly known as Himalayan germander, is a perennial herb native to the Himalayas. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Teucrium pampaninii include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties, which may help protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, diterpenes, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory effects.
